response.goal: Migrate 6 workflows from Zapier to self-hosted n8n including a form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, a Stripe payment to an email receipt, and three small Gmail filters, test them, and hand over a short doc.

plan.step: Audit existing Zapier workflows and map them to n8n logic
Rebuild form to Google Sheets and Sheets to Slack alerts workflows in n8n
Rebuild Stripe payment, email receipt, and the three Gmail filters in n8n
Test all 6 workflows with the client and create short handover documentation

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Workflow Migration and Rebuild
milestones.deliverable: All 6 Zaps rebuilt in self-hosted n8n

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Testing and Documentation
milestones.deliverable: Workflows tested with the client and short handover doc delivered

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n instance might lack proper credentials or webhook access setup.
risks.mitigation: Verify credentials and server access for Stripe, Gmail, Slack, and Google Sheets before starting migration.

risks.risk: Fixed price of $450 might be tight if any of the 6 Zaps involve complex custom code steps or edge cases.
risks.mitigation: Review all Zapier steps during the audit phase to flag complex logic early.

questions: What is the exact structure and trigger type for the form and the three Gmail filters?
Do we have admin access to the self-hosted n8n instance and all required third-party credentials?
assumptions: The client will provide credentials and access to both Zapier and the self-hosted n8n instance.
The budget of $450 covers all 6 specified workflows without additional scope creep.
